name: Otávio Müller
bio: Otávio Müller de Sá (Rio de Janeiro, August 6, 1965) is a Brazilian actor, screenwriter and director. Known for his versatility in playing characters in theater, television and cinema, his career was marked by neurotic, eccentric and anxious types, whether comical or dramatic.
